name: @w6w-apps/economic
description: Read and write customers, products, draft and booked invoices, and read orders, suppliers, accounts and bookkeeping entries in Visma e-conomic accounting.

w6w.longDescription:
e-conomic (Visma e-conomic) is a cloud accounting system for small and mid-sized businesses, used mostly in Denmark and the Nordics. This app connects a workflow to an agreement's books through the e-conomic REST API, with the two tokens e-conomic issues: the App Secret Token that identifies the integration and the Agreement Grant Token granted by the customer.

A workflow can list and read customers and create or delete them, and do the same for products; list customer groups, product groups, payment terms, VAT zones, layouts, units and employees (the reference data a new customer, product or invoice needs); create a draft invoice with its lines, delete a draft, book it (optionally sending it by email or EAN e-invoice), and list or read draft and booked invoices. It can also list draft orders, suppliers, the chart of accounts, accounting years and the bookkeeping entries of a year, and read the connected agreement.

Every list takes e-conomic's filter and sort expressions and returns the page with a total and the page to ask for next. Health checks read e-conomic's status page for its dedicated REST API component, probe the API's reachability, and verify the tokens against the agreement.
